text.intro: From my first job at 14 to working as a Global Retirement & Benefits Actuary at Willis Towers Watson.
text.story-copy: I worked through college, taking on roles in hospitality, campus life, and beyond. Here are a few chapters that led to where I am today.
text.career-copy-1: I started working at 14 as a restaurant server.
text.career-copy-2: At 16, I became a barista and cashier, and continued working through college.
text.career-copy-3: At 20, I worked as a cashier in a sushi store in the US.
text.career-copy-4: I worked as a custodian during summer and winter breaks.
text.career-copy-5: During a semester break in Malaysia, I cared for my mother while she was ill. During that time, I also worked as a mathematics and English tutor and packed screws in a factory.
text.career-when-6: AGE 21 · FINAL TWO YEARS OF COLLEGE
text.career-copy-6: At 21, I became a resident assistant, a role I held for my final two years of college.
text.career-copy-7: At 23, I became a Global Retirement & Benefits Actuary at Willis Towers Watson, where I work today.
